name: WMI Permanent Event Subscription
os_min: Windows XP (WMI infrastructure); technique common from Windows 7+
purpose: Lets code execute automatically when a defined WMI event occurs (e.g. process start, time, logon), providing fileless, reboot-surviving persistence.
normal_baseline: Subscriptions correspond to known monitoring/management software (SCCM, AV agents); a subscription is only active when filter, consumer, and binding all exist.
anomalies: CommandLineEventConsumer or ActiveScriptEventConsumer with an unrecognized command or obfuscated script
wmic.exe or mofcomp.exe process creating filter/consumer objects
anti_forensic_notes: Leaves no on-disk executable if using a script consumer, making it a favored fileless technique; corroborate with Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operational Event ID 5861 and Sysmon Event IDs 19/20/21 for a live-log view of when it was installed or fired.
